in_english.meaning: a Christian name meaning victory and strength, common in Scandinavian cultures
in_english.long_meaning: Torben is a Christian name with origins in Scandinavian cultures, meaning victory and strength. It is derived from the Old Norse name Thorbern, composed of Thor (the Norse god of thunder) and bern (bear). In the Christian tradition, Torben symbolizes the triumph of good over evil and the strength of faith. The name has been popular in Denmark and Norway for centuries and is still commonly given to boys in these countries today.

data.cultural_impact: The name Thor is synonymous with power and protection in Norse mythology. A person named Thor or Thorbern would be seen as strong, courageous, and fearless.
data.spiritual_significance: For ancient Norse, Thor represented the guardian of humanity and the Defender of Temperance in the vast cosmos. As a Christian name, it serves as a reminder of God's protection and the power of the divine name in one's life.
